title: CIFQA：用于金融查询回答的确定性工具接地多智能体LLM框架
summary: CIFQA是一个确定性工具接地的多智能体LLM框架，用于计算密集型金融问答。它通过专门智能体分离语言理解与数值执行，使用确定性Python工具进行金融计算。在定期存款查询基准上达到95.54%的准确率，显著优于直接LLM基线，且17B开源模型优于更大模型，表明架构设计比模型规模更重要。
summary_en: CIFQA is a deterministic tool-grounded multi-agent LLM framework for calculation-intensive financial QA. It separates language understanding from numerical execution via specialized agents and deterministic Python tools, achieving 95.54% accuracy on fixed deposit queries, outperforming larger models, highlighting architecture over scale.
